name: Maha Paitantaka Rasa

sections.overview: Maha Paitantaka Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Maha Paitantaka Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation that is known to be prepared from the combination of herbs and bhasma. This is enriched with various properties that treat various ailments occurring in the body.
sections.ingredients:
Javitri – Myristica fragrans 
 Jaiphal – Myristica fragrans 
 Jatamansi – Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Kuth – Saussurea costus 
 Talispatra – Abies webbiana 
 Swarna bhasma – Gold calx 
 Loha bhasma – Iron calx 
 Abhrak bhasma – Mica clax 
 Rajat bhasma – Silver calx 

 Method of preparation 

 Take all the ingredients up to 50 grams except rajata bhasma. Take rajata bhasma up to 400 grams. 
 Take all the ingredients in Mortar and add water in it. With the help of pestle, make the paste. 
 Take the paste up to 250 mg and make its pills. 
 Dry the pills under shade and store. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Maha Paitantaka Rasa is an effective Ayurvedic medicine used to manage the pitta disorders in body. Natural ingredients used in the formulation of this medicine, help to reduce the heat in body. In the case of, Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), this medicine helps to increase the digestive fire and remove the accumulated toxins (ama) from body. It helps to manage the symptoms associated with IBS like abdominal pain or cramping, diarrhea or constipation, bloated feeling, gas, mucus in stools etc. Whereas use of this medicine is also quite good in the ulcerative colitis as it helps to manage the inflammation of colon and rectum. It also helps to provide relief in the rectal bleeding. Maha Paitantaka Rasa is considered as a good medicine to remove the impurities from blood. Calming action of this medicine is good to manage the various other bleeding disorders like nasal bleeding, anal bleeding, internal bleeding etc.
sections.indications:
In all kinds of pittaj diseases 
 Heat in body 
 Abnormal bleeding disorders 
 Impurities of blood
sections.dosage: One pill two times a day with water.
sections.contraindications:
Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Maha Paitantaka Rasa – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavalii, first part, page number – 394. 
 Introduction

 Ingredients 
 
 Javitri – Myristica fragrans 
 Jaiphal – Myristica fragrans 
 Jatamansi – Nardostachys jatamansi

 Talispatra – Abies webbiana 
 Swarna bhasma – Gold calx 
 Loha bhasma – Iron calx 
 Abhrak bhasma – Mica clax 
 Rajat bhasma – Silver calx 
 
 Method of preparation 
 
 Take all the ingredients up to 50 grams except rajata bhasma. Take rajata bhasma up to 400 grams. 
 Take all the ingredients in Mortar and add water in it. With the help of pestle, make the paste. 
 Take the paste up to 250 mg and make its pills. 
 Dry the pills under shade and store. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Maha Paitantaka Rasa is an effective Ayurvedic medicine used to manage the pitta disorders in body. Natural ingredients used in the formulation of this medicine, help to reduce the heat in body. In the case of, Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), this medicine helps to increase the digestive fire and remove the accumulated toxins (ama) from body. It helps to manage the symptoms associated with IBS like abdominal pain or cramping, diarrhea or constipation, bloated feeling, gas, mucus in stools etc. Whereas use of this medicine is also quite good in the ulcerative colitis as it helps to manage the inflammation of colon and rectum. It also helps to provide relief in the rectal bleeding. Maha Paitantaka Rasa is considered as a good medicine to remove the impurities from blood. Calming action of this medicine is good to manage the various other bleeding disorders like nasal bleeding, anal bleeding, internal bleeding etc. 
 Indications 
 
 In all kinds of pittaj diseases 
 Heat in body 
 Abnormal bleeding disorders 
 Impurities of blood 
 
 Dosage

 Contraindications

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
